title: Comatosed
body:
> “On Saturday he ate through one piece of chocolate cake, one ice-cream cone, one pickle, one slice of Swiss cheese, one slice of salami, one lollipop, one piece of cherry pie, one sausage, one cupcake, and one slice of watermelon. […] But he was still hungry.”
> — The Very Hungry Caterpillar, Eric Carle

> "Not even if it rained gold coins would we have our fill of sensual pleasures."
> — Dhammapada 186

title: Into the Chrysalis
body:
<!-- Paste Part II epigraphs as blockquotes. -->

> "I cannot make you understand. I cannot make anyone understand what is happening inside me. I cannot even explain it to myself."
> — Metamorphosis, Kafka

> "Just as fire reduces wood to ashes, so does the fire of knowledge burn to ashes all reactions to material activities."
> — Bhagavad Gita 4.37

title: Wings
body:
> "The dream is ended: this is the morning."
> — Aslan in Chronicles of Narnia, C.S. Lewis

> "Behold, I make all things new."
> — Revelation 21:5
